lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 001: address reviewer finding

openQuestions: All stories in CAM-236's PRD (US-R1-001, US-001 through US-004, US-R2-001) now pass. Review round 2 flagged exactly one WARNING (the '### None' -> '### Local' heading residual); it is now fixed. The PRD awaits round 3 review to reach a terminal verdict (CLEAN or MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT).

Ship gotcha carried over unchanged from US-004/US-R1-001: the currently-INSTALLED cam binary (pre-this-PR) still compares === 'none' internally, so this PR's own `cam ship --finalize` may read 'local' from the now-migrated project.toml and skip the local issue-file close for CAM-236 -- the operator/orchestrator may need to close the issue file manually or rebuild+reinstall the binary before shipping this PRD.

Two remaining 'none' mentions stay deliberately out of AC scope (carried over from US-004/round-1/round-2): `.claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md:72` (`issue_system = none` in an edge-case checklist bullet) and `scripts/cam/patterns.md:46` (the finalizeCycleClose hardening bullet, itself a knowledge doc not a code path).

scripts/build-release.sh AC4 smoke still passes '--issue-system none' to the compiled binary (carried over from US-001/US-002/US-003; still out of scope -- no story in CAM-236 touched build-release.sh).
nextStoryContext: US-R2-001 resolved review round 2's single WARNING finding: templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md:270 (and its .claude/agents/ mirror, plus the embedded src/vendor/_generated.ts bundle) still had a '### None' subsection heading inside the 'Issue system integration' section, mirroring the issue_system enum (### Linear / ### GitHub / ### None) that US-004 had migrated everywhere else. US-004's AC3 oracle only pinned the boot-context bullet at line 60, so this heading-as-enum-value slipped through both US-004 and round 1 review. Fix was mechanical: renamed the heading to '### Local' in both raw doc copies, then ran `bun run embed-vendor` (verified clean via `embed-vendor:check`) to refresh the generated bundle. No test changes were needed (no test asserted the exact heading text; only the reviewer's own file-assert oracle did). All quality gates green on this commit: typecheck 0 errors, bun test 3951 pass/0 fail, bun run check:all (lint/file-size/debt-markers/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity) all ok. Next reviewer round should re-run all oracles fresh across the full story set; no new code surface beyond this 4-file mechanical rename.
